description:
Add a new address entry to the StarShipIt address book for reuse in future orders.

**When to use:** Use this when a contact's details need to be saved for repeated use — e.g. a frequent supplier, warehouse, or customer. Once saved, addresses can be retrieved via `starshipit_list_addresses` and assigned to orders without re-entering details.

**Required fields:**
- `name` — full name of the contact
- `street` — street address
- `post_code` — postcode
- `country` — country name (e.g. "Australia") or ISO code (e.g. "AU")

**Optional fields:**
- `code` — your custom reference code for quick lookup
- `company`, `suburb`, `city`, `state`
- `phone`, `email`
- `instructions` — courier delivery instructions
- `building` — building name or apartment number
- `carrier` — preferred carrier ID (0 = no preference)
- `signature_required` — whether delivery requires a signature

**Returns:** The newly created address object including its assigned `id`.

**Errors:**
- 400 — missing required fields (name, street, post_code, country) or validation failure
- 409 — address with the same code may already exist
- 401/403 — authentication failure

**Example:**
```json
{
  "address": {
    "code": "MELB-WH",
    "name": "Warehouse Manager",
    "company": "Acme Logistics",
    "street": "55 Bourke St",
    "suburb": "Melbourne",
    "city": "Melbourne",
    "state": "VIC",
    "post_code": "3000",
    "country": "Australia",
    "phone": "0398765432",
    "email": "warehouse@acme.com",
    "signature_required": false
  }
}
```

code.description: Custom reference code for this address (e.g. "SUPPLIER-001")

instructions.description: Delivery instructions for the courier (e.g. "Leave at front door")

signature_required.description: Whether a signature is required on delivery

name: starshipit_add_address

outputSchema.description: Raw StarShipIt API response; not truncated

errors.description: Validation or processing errors returned by StarShipIt

object.description: The response payload when StarShipIt returns a non-object value

success.description: StarShipIt success flag (a boolean on most endpoints)

title: Add Address to Address Book
